title: C1M (Duo)
description:
Nothing like this exists on phones yet. ChatGPT and Claude work as a pair. Smartphone orchestration of the strongest AIs — no subscriptions, no extra fees, no server, no card.

C1M is the open source of Duo and Trio, iPhone shortcuts from the Poly A1 family: ChatGPT answers, Claude checks, right on the phone through the apps' own actions — no server.

Website, demo and install: https://polyhelper.ai/duo/
